bio: 5th President of the Republic of Kenya, previously serving as Deputy President and Minister for Agriculture.
Governor of Nairobi City County, former Senator of Nairobi and Nominated MP. Focused on urban planning and youth empowerment.
First female Governor of Homa Bay County, former Chairperson of the National Assembly Finance and Planning Committee.
Governor of Mombasa County, former Member of Parliament for Mvita Constituency and Chairperson of PIC.
First female Chief Justice of Kenya and President of the Supreme Court, with over 33 years of legal experience.
Deputy President of Kenya, former Member of Parliament for Mathira Constituency and career administrator.
Speaker of the National Assembly, former Senator for Bungoma and Minister for Foreign Affairs.
Speaker of the Senate, former Governor of Kilifi County and Member of Parliament for Magarini.
Attorney General of Kenya, former Speaker of the National Assembly and Magistrate.
Prime Cabinet Secretary and CS for Foreign & Diaspora Affairs, former Vice President and Minister for Finance.
4th President of Kenya (2013-2022). Currently serving as the Facilitator of the EAC-led Nairobi Process for Peace in DRC.
Former Prime Minister of Kenya (2008-2013) and African Union High Representative for Infrastructure Development. Candidate for AUC Chairmanship.
Member of Parliament for Kikuyu and Majority Leader in the National Assembly. Member of the Parliamentary Service Commission.
Governor of Kilifi County. Previously served as the CAS for Lands and MP for Kilifi North and Malindi.
Governor of Uasin Gishu County. Former administrator focused on agricultural transformation and rural development.
Governor of Kisumu County, former Senator and Minister for Medical Services. Renowned academic and political scientist.
Governor of Kirinyaga County and Chairperson of the Council of Governors. Former CS for Devolution and Planning.
Governor of Machakos County. Former CAS for Transport and MP for Kathiani. Focused on 'Chakula Mezani' initiative.
Governor of Kakamega County. Former CEO of Kenya Electricity Transmission Company (KETRACO).
Governor of Nakuru County. Former Senator of Nakuru and Speaker of Nakuru County Assembly. Lawyer by profession.
Governor of Bungoma County. Former Speaker of the Senate and first Governor of Bungoma (2013-2017).
Cabinet Secretary for Defence. Former Majority Leader of the National Assembly and long-serving MP for Garissa Town.
Cabinet Secretary for Interior and National Administration. Former Deputy Speaker of the Senate and Senator for Tharaka Nithi.
Cabinet Secretary for Roads and Transport. Former Majority Leader of the Senate and Senator for Elgeyo Marakwet.
Governor of Meru County. Former Woman Representative for Meru County and Bishop.
Governor of Nyandarua County. Focused on the 'Badilisha Maisha' economic transformation agenda.
Governor of Makueni County. Former Senator for Makueni and Minority Whip of the Senate. Advocate of the High Court.
Governor of Narok County. Former CAS for Labour and Social Protection and MP for Narok West.
Cabinet Secretary for Lands, Public Works, Housing and Urban Development. Former MP for Kandara.
Deputy Chief Justice and Vice President of the Supreme Court of Kenya. Over 37 years in the legal profession.
Cabinet Secretary for Information, Communications and the Digital Economy. Management Consultant and Economist.
Senator for Kilifi County and Minority Leader of the Senate. Retired Judge of the Industrial Court.
